clips.title: The story
paras: Night elf priests in Ironforge are called back to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. A Sisterhood emissary seeks out acolytes abroad and sends them to Priestess Alathea for urgent training and sacred duties.

In Ironforge, night elf priests remain tied to the Sisterhood of Elune, though they are far from Teldrassil. Braenna Flintcrag, a dwarven priest trainer in the Mystic Ward, carries a message from a visiting night elf priestess. The messenger sought young disciples traveling abroad and said their mentors needed them back in the capital at once.

At the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, returning acolytes report to Priestess Alathea. Beneath the watchful gaze of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, Alathea welcomes her student and is relieved they crossed the seas safely. Their return begins further devotion and sacred duties, including the Stars of Elune.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, friend. Good to see you here in our great halls. A blessing be on you and your kind.

While you were traveling through our lands, a priestess of your temple came here seeking you. She said that you were to return to the Temple of the Moon as soon as possible. I'm sorry I can't tell you more, but it did sound important. When you get to the temple, speak to a Priestess Alathea.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, you've returned home, friend. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
